BiblicalUsage: Adiynow — 'his spear' — appears once, in the list of David's mighty men, where the text names Adino the Eznite, chief among the captains, who 'lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.' The name itself is bound up with the weapon: the man is remembered by the spear he lifted and the battle he won alone against eight hundred.
TheologicalSignificance: Its contribution is small and specific, and whatever it adds to my faith comes through the passage that uses it; in this case, the verse is 2 Samuel 23:8.
